C0800.title: Third-Party Contractor Leaks Bank Customer Information
C0800.summary: Xiaomeng, an employee of a company stationed at a Karamay office, was assigned to assist bank staff with e-banking marketing. During this assistance, Xiaomeng exploited their position to illegally provide obtained customer personal information, such as mobile phone numbers, to others, resulting in the unlawful use of multiple victims' information.
